check_box.label: Shade hair with head, neck, shoulders
check_box.name: ks_hair_occ_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Your head, neck and shoulders block the sun, moon and local lights on your own alpha-blended hair and attachments, and darken them next to the body. Light shining straight in is kept. Your view only.

check_box.label: Show proxies
check_box.name: ks_hair_occ_show_proxies
check_box.tool_tip: Draws the head, neck and shoulder shapes as wireframes. Never appears in snapshots.

combo_box.name: ks_hair_occ_debug
combo_box.tool_tip: Shows the effect as grey on your own alpha: white = unchanged, black = fully blocked or darkened.

slider.label: Shadow
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_light_strength
slider.tool_tip: How much the shapes block lights.

slider.label: Darkening
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_ao_strength
slider.tool_tip: How much hair right next to the body is darkened.

slider.label: Reach (m)
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_ao_fade
slider.tool_tip: Distance from the shapes over which the darkening fades out.

slider.label: Inside (m)
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_ao_inside
slider.tool_tip: Depth inside a shape where the darkening is full.

slider.label: Straight-in
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_open_angle
slider.tool_tip: How directly a light must shine in from outside to skip the darkening. Smaller: more lights count as shining in.

slider.label: Facing away
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_ao_normal
slider.tool_tip: Less darkening on surfaces that face away from the body. Hair normals are often unreliable; 0 ignores them.

slider.label: Head (m)
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_head_radius
slider.tool_tip: Head sphere radius, scaled with your head size. 0 turns it off. Keep it a little inside the scalp.

slider.label: Neck (m)
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_neck_radius
slider.tool_tip: Neck capsule radius, scaled with your head size. 0 turns it off.

slider.label: Shoulders (m)
slider.name: ks_hair_occ_shoulder_radius
slider.tool_tip: Shoulder capsule radius, scaled with your shoulder width. 0 turns them off.
